note: SYNTHETIC locked-matrix mock for the Classifier Eval Suite. Numbers are design placeholders, not measured eval results. Pass A metrics are identical across Pass B efforts within each model, matching the bank-once design. Calibration fields derive from one set of 100 synthetic rows per model. Costs use production-owned normal Responses prices, cached-input rates, and the explicit 37,746-row offline fallback. No Batch discount is applied. Replace this mock with a new paid sweep before interpreting model performance.
